title: Phased-array beam pattern
line: 16 elements steered to 20 degrees, with and without a taper.
description: Beam pattern of a 16-element half-wavelength array steered to 20 degrees, uniform weights against a Hamming taper: the taper trades a wider beam for lower sidelobes.
thumbnailAlt: Beam patterns of a 16-element array with uniform and Hamming weights, rendered by RunMat
